body.title: bazel/dbaczynski/BAZEL-3699
body.description:
Review this PR commit by commit. 

Main changes:
- The sync console shows all project view problems, with their file and line. An error stops the sync.
- The editor highlights a required import that has no file.
- Inspect Code shows the quick fixes of project view problems.
- A `# suppress: <id>` comment above an item or a section suppresses its warning. 
- The monorepo `.bazelproject` files suppress the warnings of the sections that the Bazel plugin before 263 still needs.

messages.text: I changed it to `ProjectViewService.getInstance` because IDE suggests that when .service is used.

Since you already touched this, it'd be great to refactor the TaskConsole and get rid of `registerException` method from console API. The method is ugly and was introduced as a quick and dirty fix to prevent the same error displayed on multiple levels. It would be better to handle this case inside console implementation based on provided failed result, and prevent displaying error if previously the same failure result was displayed

It does not seem to have any purpose here. It was updated like regular field (not using e.g. update {}) and never collected.  Current implementation seems to have the same properties as the previous one, just does not provide observability, which was not used. Do you have any plans for that?
Let's leave it this way, we can add it back when needed.
I'd still prefer it, if we'd drop this option for the CLion specific part.

Your comment is on the main monorepo `.bazelproject`. The `clwb.bazelproject` dose not contain this option. 

Also, if there are no "pre 263 Bazel plugin" consumers of the `clwb.bazelproject` I can migrate/remove those old options already.
Wait sorry, probably got lost in the diff.
